name: No-good Noelle
source:
Noelle and Ivy's friendship starts falling apart when only one of them gets accepted as a Snowflake Maker apprentice.

Will you attempt to fix things, or move on to something even worse?

[From Itch.io]
translation:
当诺艾尔与艾薇之中只有一人被录取为“造雪师”学徒时，两人之间的友谊开始出现裂痕。

你会试着挽回这段关系，还是走向更糟糕的境地？

[引自Itch.io]
